lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Concept model C: substitution or equivalent reasoning

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example is written more briefly. Fill in the reasoning it leaves out.

items.prompt: Solve the system: y = 2x + 1 and 3x + y = 11.

steps: Substitute y = 2x + 1 into the second equation: 3x + (2x + 1) = 11.
Combine like terms: 5x + 1 = 11, so 5x = 10 and x = 2.
Substitute x = 2 back into y = 2x + 1 to get y = 5, so the solution is (2, 5).

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt:
Solve the system:
6x + 3y = -36
-6x + 4y = -34
Use elimination to find the solution (x, y).
Classify the system: y = -9x + 22 and y = -6x - 30. Does it have one solution, no solution, or infinitely many solutions?
The reference equation is y = -3x + 6. Which of these equations, paired with the reference, would give the system infinitely many solutions?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Plan A charges a $18 flat fee plus $6 per month. Plan B charges a $50 flat fee plus $2 per month. After how many months do the two plans cost the same, and what is that cost?
Plan A charges a $33 flat fee plus $5 per visit. Plan B charges a $12 flat fee plus $8 per visit. The solution to the system is (7, 68). What does this solution represent?
choices: Plan A costs $68 more than Plan B after 7 visits.

items.prompt: System: y = -8x + 106 and y = -2x + 34. Does the point (13, 8) satisfy both equations, fail one, or fail both?
Plan A charges a $38 flat fee plus $7 per visit. Plan B charges a $39 flat fee plus $6 per visit. The solution to the system is (1, 45). What does the y-coordinate of the solution represent?
choices: The number of visits after which the two plans cost the same.
The difference in cost between the two plans.
The shared cost, in dollars, when the two plans are equal.
The rate Plan B charges per visit.

items.prompt: System: y = -x - 7 and y = -2x - 22. Which point (x, y) satisfies both equations?

items.prompt: Solve the system: y = x + 9 and y = -x - 1. What is the intersection point (x, y)?
Relationship A: x: 3, 4, 5, 6 y: 1, -1, -3, -5. Relationship B: x: 3, 4, 5, 6 y: 1, 6, 11, 16. At which x-value do the two relationships have the same y-value?
